title: KV-COBRA: KV Cache Compression via Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What limits KV-cache compression at extreme bit-rates? We argue that it is not the choice of compression scheme, but how its budget is allocated across attention heads. Existing methods apply rank and bit-width uniformly, ignoring that each head has a different optimal mix of rank truncation and quantization. We show that co-optimizing rank and bit-width per head, using only standard low-rank projection and scalar quantization, dominates uniform allocation, with the largest gains at low bit-rates. Our method, KV-COBRA (Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation), formalizes this as a resource-allocation problem: it balances rank-truncation loss against quantization loss within each head, then redistributes budget across heads to minimize total distortion. translated_title: KV-COBRA：通过位宽-秩协同优化分配实现KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 在极端比特率下，是什么限制了KV缓存的压缩？我们认为，限制因素并非压缩方案的选择，而是其预算在各个注意力头之间的分配方式。现有方法对秩和位宽采用统一分配，忽视了每个头在秩截断与量化之间具有不同的最优组合。我们证明，仅使用标准的低秩投影和标量量化，对每个头的秩和位宽进行协同优化，其效果即可超越统一分配，且在低比特率下收益最大。我们的方法KV-COBRA（协同优化位宽-秩分配）将此问题形式化为一个资源分配问题：它在每个头内部平衡秩截断损失与量化损失，然后在各头之间重新分配预算以最小化总失真。融合的Hadamard旋转使各通道方差均衡化，而按注意力KL散度重要性对SVD基进行重排序使求解器具备查询感知能力。同一分配器还可扩展至K+V联合压缩。
tldr: 该论文提出KV-COBRA方法，将KV缓存压缩建模为资源分配问题，通过在每个注意力头内部协同优化秩截断与量化位宽的权衡并在头间重新分配预算，在低比特率下显著优于传统的统一分配方案。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes KV-COBRA, which formulates KV cache compression as a resource allocation problem that co-optimizes rank truncation and quantization bit-width within each attention head and redistributes budget across heads, significantly outperforming uniform allocation at low bit-rates.
